title: Image CAPTCHA for Contact Form 7 and WPForms through 3.3.29 contains a CAPTCHA bypass vulnerability that allows…
description: A vulnerability in Image CAPTCHA for Contact Form 7 and WPForms up to version 3.3.29 allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass CAPTCHA protections by using a hardcoded static answer. This flaw enables attackers to submit automated spam through forms protected by this CAPTCHA mechanism.
